runs.name: SSAB AB; Sweden, Nasdaq Stockholm SSAB A and SSAB B with a secondary listing on Nasdaq Helsinki, not an SEC registrant (EDGAR holds only the ADR facilities' F-6 and F-6EF filings), OTC ADR one ADS to one-half share; five segments, SSAB Special Steels, SSAB Europe, SSAB Americas, Tibnor and Ruukki Construction; IPSCO bought 2007, Rautaruukki combined 2014 in shares; Ovako Metals Oy bought by Tibnor in Q2 2026; Nucor and Cleveland-Cliffs read from their 10-Ks, Algoma (a 40-F filer) and Orion not read
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **SEK 102.20** per class B share (Nasdaq Stockholm, 2026-10-13; Yahoo chart, aggregator, flagged; class A SEK 101.45; the ADR SSAAY **US$ 5.27**, OTC, thin, one ADS to one-half share per the Citibank F-6EF of 2016-02-02, the JPMorgan F-6EF of 2016-12-06 giving the same ratio, the facility behind the ticker not confirmed). Shares **996,617,667** (295,966,330 class A, 700,651,337 class B, same rights to assets and result, no treasury shares after the cancellation of the 33,217,659 bought in 2023 to 2024; Annual Report 2025); cap **SEK 101,632M**. Sovereign **3.178%** (Sveriges Riksbank SEGVB10YC, the ten-year, the longest maturity the Riksbank publishes, 2026-10-12, said so). Filings read, from the company: Annual Reports 2025, 2024, 2023, 2021, 2020, 2018 and 2016 (2022 and 2019 from the next year's comparatives), the Q2 2026 interim report (2026-07-22); one figure cross-checked (2025 operating result SEK 6,116M across the cash flow statement, note B.1 and the ten-year summary). `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned not an SEC filer; arithmetic by hand. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report's business, risk and directors' report sections (the brief's departure), stated in the run file. Q1 IN. **Q2 OUT**: no part carries half of 2021 to 2025 segment operating result; SSAB Americas decides at 38.6% against SSAB Special Steels' 35.6%, a three-point margin (over 2016 to 2025 Special Steels' summed result, 37,111, slightly exceeds the Americas' 37,003, so a ten-year reading would make the branded part decide, recorded by the analyst); the Americas, two scrap-fed plate mills, sell commodity heavy plate at the market's price, not the low-cost producer on the filings read (behind Nucor's steel mills segment in both downturns read, 1.4% against 15.1% in 2017, a 1.9% loss against a 5.9% profit in 2020), the money test answered yes in Nucor's US$ 1.7bn Brandenburg plate mill, shipping from 2023, the Americas' operating result falling from SEK 9.65bn (2023) to SEK 2.17bn (2025); aggregate operating margin 19.4% over 2017 to 2025 against Nucor's steel mills 20.5% (25.6% against 23.6% over 2021 to 2025), Cleveland-Cliffs 4.1% consolidated over 2021 to 2025; Algoma (a 40-F filer) and Orion not read; Nucor FY2016 not fetched. The analyst's strongest case against: parity of cost by the airline row and a rival's mixed segment, under which the box would be TOO HARD (NATURE), not IN. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: quarterly outlook guidance, EBITDA the first profit line, an adjusted 2022 operating result of SEK 29,283M featured against a reported loss of SEK 4,355M (the SEK 33,291M IPSCO and Rautaruukki goodwill write-down excluded), the CEO's short-term incentive 70% on EBITDA margin against peers. Q6 facts recorded: the 2023 to 2024 buyback at an average SEK 75.5 a share, no price limit; the 2014 Rautaruukki combination paid in shares. Owner cash (operating cash less net capital spending, net acquisitions and lease principal) all-equity SEK 8,649M over 2021 to 2025, 5,964M over 2016 to 2025, (1,538)M in 2025; maintenance case 11,548M and 7,666M. Balance sheets 2015 to mid-2026: goodwill of about SEK 30bn written off in the 2022 record year; borrowings SEK 27.1bn to 7.4bn, helped by the 2016 SEK 4.9bn rights issue; cash peaked SEK 28.9bn (2023), SEK 19.7bn at mid-2026, net cash SEK 12.3bn on the run's basis (leases excluded); SEK 46,968M of committed Oxelosund and Lulea spending within five years; contingent liabilities SEK 18.8bn, mostly Lulea guarantees. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: all-equity range **SEK 211 to 288** per class B share (US$ 10.62 to 14.49 per ADS) against SEK 102.20, on the two-cycle base 2016 to 2025 under specific (a) (2021 aberrational in the filer's words), maintenance case central, growth cut to sales growth and capped at the sovereign; fair **SEK 62.8** all-equity (US$ 3.16 per ADS), **SEK 48.7** equity-only (US$ 2.45), not armed, the box being OUT at Q2; no central case earns the floor at the price. A CONVENTION of the run: the committed SEK 46,968M transformation charged in every central case as the cost of staying in place (without it fair SEK 98.5; on the literal 2021 to 2025 window SEK 106.5); another: interest tax at the Swedish statutory 20.6%. Contamination declared by the analyst: the OUTKY commit subjects in its opening context (a European steel producer closed OUT at Q2), weighed in the file; memory-index lines; other runs' research-folder names in the git status; the `_overnight.lock` name from a filtered listing of `Screens/_daily/`; none opened or used. Commits 55d88f2b, 59025f92, 4f8565ec, 6897ef78. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Citations: the analyst's `check_citations.py` clean (50 ids, 16 fragments); the dispatcher's `_dispatcher_cite_check.py` 50 ids, 14 quoted cites, no missing id, no E-id, one hit: "shown on the evidence to be filling in" beside **[M2011-015]** is the framework's own Q2 wording, labelled "(Q2, The routing with Q1)" before the id, recorded as a placement slip (an id beside the framework's wording), not fixed in the run file. No tracked research file over 200 KB. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) whether a margin comparison against a rival's mixed segment counts as a cost position read from the filings, and whether the money test alone can close a commodity part OUT without a cost figure (the alternative reading is TOO HARD (NATURE)); (2) the parts threshold on a knife edge whose winner turns on the five-year against the ten-year window; (3) Q7 silent on a signed capital programme of about half the market value that replaces the production base rather than buying growth. Could not get: the 2022 and 2019 annual reports, Nucor FY2016 segment data, the ADR facility behind SSAAY, a Swedish yield longer than ten years.
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: SSAB Americas decides on a knife edge (38.6% of 2021 to 2025 segment operating result against Special Steels' 35.6%; over ten years the branded part would decide), commodity heavy plate at the market's price, not the low-cost producer on the filings read (behind Nucor's steel mills in the 2017 and 2020 troughs), its castle crossed by Nucor's US$ 1.7bn Brandenburg plate mill, operating result SEK 9.65bn (2023) to 2.17bn (2025); TOO HARD (NATURE) recorded by the analyst as the alternative reading. Integrity facts recorded, not judged: quarterly outlook guidance, EBITDA featured, an adjusted 2022 result featured against a reported loss, CEO pay 70% on EBITDA margin. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: all-equity range SEK 211 to 288 against SEK 102.20, fair SEK 62.8 all-equity, SEK 48.7 equity-only, not armed, the SEK 47bn Lulea and Oxelosund commitment charged as a run convention. Framework gaps for the operator: margins against a mixed rival segment as a cost reading; the parts threshold turning on the window; committed replacement capital in Q7.
